item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 15 November 2023, the Bundestag debated the federal government's bill proposing a self-determination procedure for changing legal sex entries and first names through a declaration at the civil registry, replacing the Transsexuals Act and removing requirements for two expert assessments and, in relevant cases, a medical certificate.","notes":["The excerpt supports the date, proposed procedure, replacement of the Transsexuals Act, and removal of the assessment and medical-certificate requirements.","The excerpt identifies the bill as the federal government's bill but does not establish the Scholz attribution."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The 2023 government bill proposed a three-month advance registration period and a one-year waiting period before a further change; for minors aged at least 15, self-declaration would require legal-representative consent, with possible replacement of that consent by a family court when the change did not conflict with the child's welfare.","notes":["The excerpt specifies minors aged at least 15, not 14 and above."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports these proposed provisions and related areas of regulation, including contractual freedom, house rules, quotas, registers, documents, parent-child relationships, and military service."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the Bundesrat's dated criticism, its concern about parental control for minors up to age 14, and the federal government's rejection of the criticism and opposition to general family-court involvement."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the date, public hearing, expert attribution, recommendation concerning age and parental consent, and concerns about data transmission, data protection, and deterrence."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the stakeholder support and requested changes concerning registration and waiting periods, anti-discrimination, disclosure protections, data transmission, house rules, and parentage rules."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the reported expert concerns about sauna and women's-shelter access, partial legal deterioration, minor protections, and possible misuse without exploring the reasons for a change."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R04-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Bundestag referred government bill 20/9049 and AfD motion 20/8203 for further consideration.","notes":["The excerpt supports the referral and document numbers.","The supplied excerpt does not itself establish that this occurred following a first reading on 15 November 2023 or characterize the AfD motion as opposing."]}]}
